ret: 1 training day (A) holding 2 exercises, over block weeks train, repeating.
Block weeks: train, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid.
Rotation: Alternate Day A, 2 sessions per training week.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 2 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
machine: 3 sets of 5 reps on Barbell Back Squat; add 5 lb after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight.

barbell: 3 sets of 5 reps on Barbell Bench Press; add 2.5 kg after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight. Loads on a 5 lb grid (this slot's grid).
3 sets of 5 reps on Barbell Back Squat; add 5 lb after every session where all sets hit; after 3 misses in a row, propose dropping to 90% of the weight
Reads your estimated max (kept on file; ignored once older than 56 days).
Starts with working weight = the load you could lift for 5 reps with 1 in reserve, given an estimated max of your estimated max for Barbell Back Squat; written by session, owner.
Starts with missed sessions in a row = 0; written by session.
Plan: Barbell Back Squat: 3 sets of 5 reps at your working weight.

After each session:
    - if every working set reached its target: Set working weight to whichever is known first: (1) your working weight plus 5 lb; (2) the best load you logged on “work”; set missed sessions in a row to 0.
    - if a working set fell short:
      - if your missed sessions in a row plus 1 is at least 3: Set missed sessions in a row to 0; and propose, for your OK: set working weight to 90% of your working weight.
      - otherwise: Raise missed sessions in a row by 1.
    - if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: Leave everything as is.
